hooks.command: CMD="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|]\s*)git\s+(push\s+.*(--force|-f\b)|push\s+\S+\s+\+|merge\b|reset\s+--hard|branch\s+(-D\b|--delete\s+--force)|clean\s+-f)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"permissionDecision": "deny"}, "systemMessage": "Blocked: destructive or self-merge git operation. Per AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and docs/agents/operating-model.md, no agent may force-push, merge, hard-reset, or force-delete branches in this repository \u2014 only a human may do this, through the reviewed pull-request workflow."}' >&2; exit 2; fi
